business_summary: Zhubo Design Co., Ltd engages in the architectural design and related business in China. The company offers design and consulting services, such as architectural design, urban planning, and interior design services. It undertakes various project works, such as urban design and renewal, complex and super high rise, medical treatment and pension, office and industrial park, school and culture architecture, hospitality/leisure, high and low-density residential, and exhibition area and boutique space. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
